answer: At deployment, every node crafts a local ridge of recent parachain blocks that form a ripple hash. To stay anchored, each agent must rebroadcast a slice of the ripple within 196 ms or lose reputation weight. A fake identity must source fresh ripple slices from uncorrelated peers it has never heard, so each Sybil forces an extra 0.42s of cross-epoch peering time, a human-scale gap no botting farm can compress.
